title: Minstrel shows and vaudeville comedy
summary: They talk about minstrel shows, the Lyric and Palace theaters, Pigmeat Markham, Butterbeans and Susie, and Silas Green.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What would they have in the show? Just like a Minnesota show? Just like a Minnesota show. I've never seen a Minnesota show. I've been still packing. Back in the ocean. And they had come, you know. Singing. Singing. They sing.
Yeah. They sing like the blues and something. They have a nice voice. They sing something like opera.
You see? Do you see something like that on TV nowadays? No. Never? No.
That's gone. After when, what you call it, he hit him. He hit him. Whoopin' Fitchin'. He cut down all that. Oh, whoopin' Fitchin'. And everything.
I saw Pygmeet Markham at the Lyric. After they changed it to the palace. He still did some of those things.
Well, they had the palace and the... And the Lyric Boat. And the Lyric Boat. Yeah, well they had the palace.
That's why I got a good mix. One on each corner. Yeah, well I saw the palace. I saw Pygmeet there once. And he used to do all that. And I've seen Silas green, but they, you know, too.

Now that's a... Larry, one time I used to hear some people say they wouldn't go at the lake. Really? Uh-huh. But the palace, yeah, they always go at the pass. But Larry used to have all the, what you call the... Before the dance, you know, before the dance. Because I went there one night. One day I could call myself. Go to it there. You know, respect. Everything was just right. But the thing they said there, when I come here, I told my mother about it. She give us that laugh. She said, what if that's where you went? I said, yeah. I said, the people just screaming and holler. And I enjoyed it. But then I went there twice, but I didn't go no more. Don't want to laugh or turn their head. It brought to their water and their stomach. But then if the man and the woman is stuck, you can't see yet. Oh. On the stage. That's like I'm the actor. The actor. The actor used to act.
Yeah, I know what you're talking about. Like Butterbeens and Susie? You never saw them, huh? Grant and Wilson. A lot of funny calls. Yeah.
Butterbeens and Susie was big. Male and female. Male and male.
